spec.expr:
(sum(elasticsearch_indices_store_size_bytes_primary{namespace=~"$namespace", index=~"zeebe.*"}) * 2)
/ 
(
    sum (increase(zeebe_element_instance_events_total{namespace=~"$namespace",partition=~"$partition",pod=~"$pod", action="activated", type="PROCESS"}[$__range]))

    (sum(increase(zeebe_element_instance_events_total{namespace=~"$namespace", partition=~"$partition",pod=~"$pod", action="activated", type="CALL_ACTIVITY"}[$__range])) or vector(0))

)

spec.description:
Measures the time from writing a user command to the append-only log until the processing engine reads and starts processing.

Note: When the processing backlog is high, this measurement will be high as well.
spec.title: Write-to-Processing latency

spec.description: Measures the average number of records that can be processed per second. This is the most atomic metric we have for processing.
spec.title: Processed records per second on average

spec.description: Measures the average number of records that can be exported per second. This is the most atomic metric we have for exporting.
spec.title: Exported records per second on average

spec.description:
Measures the time from writing a user command to the append-only log until the processing engine reads and starts processing.

Combines all latency measurements in one panel to get a better overview.
spec.title: Latency overview (p50)

spec.description: Measures the average process instances that can be completed per second (root and sub-process instances).
spec.title: Completed Processes per second (PI/s) on average

spec.description:
Measures the time from writing an event to the append-only log until the exporter reads and starts exporting it.

Note: When the processing and/or exporting backlog is high, this measurement will be high as well.
spec.title: Write-to-Exporting latency

spec.description:
Measures the time from creating an instance in the client until the process instance is available via the REST API. Determining how long it takes until data is available for the user. 

Note: This is one of the strongest measures, including the complete round-trip, especially processing and exporting the backlog and the ES index fresh interval, etc
spec.title: Data available latency (p50)

spec.description: The AVG duration of exporting a record (in seconds)
spec.title: Exporting duration in seconds (avg)

spec.description: The time it takes to flush the bulk request in the Elasticsearch exporter
spec.title: Elasticsearch Exporter (Flush Duration)

spec.description:
AVG CPU usage in a second per pod and container.

container_cpu_usage_seconds_total reports the container CPU usage time per second. How much of a second was used by the container on a certain CPU.

It can be over 1 second (as we might use several CPUs). Indicating how much of a CPU second (or in this sense how many CPUs) was/is used.
spec.title: Camunda CPU usage

spec.expr: max(max (zeebe_log_appender_last_committed_position{namespace=~"$namespace", partition=~"$partition"}) by(partition) - max (zeebe_exporter_last_exported_position{namespace=~"$namespace", partition=~"$partition"}) by(partition))

spec.description: Measures the number of records that are not yet exported by the exporter (includes commands, which will be skipped)
spec.title: Current exporting backlog (queue size)

spec.description: Measures the number of records that are not yet processed by the process engine (includes events, which will be skipped)
spec.title: Current processing backlog (queue size)

spec.description: Measures the time a record is staged in the Elasticsearch exporter buffer/bulk before flushing
spec.title: Elasticsearch Exporter record buffer time

spec.description:
The average percentage of CPU periods where the container ran but was throttled (stopped from running the whole CPU period).


container_cpu_cfs_periods_total -
Number of elapsed enforcement period intervals
container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total -
Number of throttled period intervals

https://stackoverflow.com/a/67316429/2165134
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UE7QX98-kO0
spec.title: CPU Throttling (AVG)

spec.description:
Measures the average number of indexed documents per second in Elasticsearch
Note: The records in Camunda != the Documents to be indexed in Elasticsearch, as data gets duplicated and some records get merged.
spec.title: Elasticsearch documents indexed per second on average

spec.description:

spec.title: Write-to-Exporting latency (p50)

spec.description:
Measures the time from writing a user command to the append-only log until the processing engine reads and starts processing.

Note: When the processing backlog is high, this measurement will be high as well.
spec.title: Write-to-Processing latency (p50)

spec.description:
Measures the time from creating an instance in the client until the process instance is available via the REST API. Determining how long it takes until data is available for the user.

spec.description: Measures the percentage of dropped requests
spec.title: Backpressure dropping requests per second

spec.description: Measures the average flow node instances that can be completed per second.
spec.title: Flow node instances per second (FNI/s) on average

spec.description: Measures the average number of service task instances that can be completed
spec.title: Service tasks per second (STI/s) on average

spec.description: Measures the average number of jobs that can be completed per second.
spec.title: Jobs per second (J/s) on average

spec.description: Measures the average number of archived PIs per second.
spec.title: Archived Processes per second (PI/s) on average

spec.description:
Measures the time from creating an instance until completion. The full process instance execution time.

Note: This is measured in the Metric exporter
Note: This is one of the strongest measures, including the complete round-trip, especially processing and exporting the backlog and the ES index fresh interval, etc.
spec.title: Process instance execution time

spec.description: Measures the time a record is staged in the Camunda Exporter buffer/bulk before flushing
spec.title: Camunda Exporter record buffer time

spec.description: The time it takes to flush the bulk request in the Camunda exporter
spec.title: Camunda Exporter (Flush Duration)

spec.description:
Measures the time a record is staged in the Camunda Exporter buffer/bulk before flushing
Note: When the processing and/or exporting backlog is high, this measurement will be high as well.
spec.title: Camunda exporter flush latency

spec.description: Memory limits and requests are taken from the k8 pod metrics.
spec.title: Process memory usage in %

spec.description:
Total amount of memory reserved for the JVM, where:

- Used means currently in use by live objects
- Committed means allocated to the JVM by the OS, and guaranteed to be available for usage
- Max means maximum possible committed memory, but not guaranteed
spec.title: JVM Memory usage

spec.expr: sum by(pod, container, service) (rate(container_fs_writes_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", container!=""}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.description: Measures the number of write operations that are executed per second
spec.title: Write IOPS per second on average
